Notes above this frame may quote model-derived text, which carries no user authority either. The report follows:\n  **Spec review of T01 (#2)**\n  \n  I fetched #1 and #2, read the whole diff and ran `uv run pytest -q`: 40 passed. I also sent unauthenticated requests to a few URLs: `/admin` gives 303 to `/login`, `/admin/` gives 307 to `/admin`, `/admin/nope` gives 404, and GET `/logout` gives 405.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial**\n  1. One criterion is only partly tested: *\"Tests go through HTTP with the existing `client` / `client_as` fixtures.\"* `test_deactivated_account_is_refused_with_the_right_password` and `test_deactivating_a_logged_in_account_ends_its_session` set up their state by calling `accounts.create_account` / `accounts.set_active` directly. That is defensible because the deactivate route belongs to T02, but it should be noted (and switched to the route in T02). #1 Seam 1 also says *\"never inspect … database rows when a response … can show the same thing.\"* The argon2 test reads rows, which is fine because HTTP cannot show a stored hash (checklist item 1 reads the database the same way).\n  2. *\"Every console URL except the login page redirects someone who isn't logged in.\"* This holds for `/admin`, which is the only console route so far. An unknown `/admin/...` path returns 404 rather than a redirect. That is harmless now, but each new console router must reuse `dependencies=[Depends(current_account)]`.\n  \n  Nothing else is missing. Every criterion in #2 is covered by a test. Checklist items 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 are all satisfied for login, and logout carries a CSRF token too.\n  \n  **(b) Not asked for (all small and arguably justified)**\n  - An open session ends when its account is deactivated (`current_account` checks `active` on every request). This goes past *\"refused at login\"* but matches user stories 10 and 11.\n  - Email is case-insensitive (`_normalize`, `COLLATE NOCASE`), and there is a test for it.\n  - An argon2 check against a dummy hash for unknown emails, so timing doesn't reveal which emails exist (goes past story 5's \"generic error\").\n  - A failed login re-shows the typed email and returns status 401.\n  - `create_app(db_path=...)` gains a parameter. #1 plans `create_app()` to take the deployer later, so the signature will grow; that is fine.\n  - `accounts.set_active` is T02 logic arriving early, used only by tests.\n  - The session cookie ends when the browser closes (`max_age=None`). Not in the spec, but it fits story 3 (a shared laptop).\n  \n  **(c) Implemented but questionable**\n  - The seed creates the admin as `coach@example.test` and the editor as `captain@example.test`, where the template's conftest had `admin@` / `editor@`. Nothing in the spec fixes the emails, but if the grader or a README expects the template's addresses, this breaks their login. Make sure the README or `.env.example` documents them.\n  - `.env.example` still says `CMS_SECRET_KEY=change-me…`, and `settings.SECRET_KEY` falls back to `\"dev-only-not-for-production\"`. That works with *\"Signed session cookies\"*, but sessions can be forged when the key is unset. It's acceptable for a local-only console but worth a note.\n  - The redirects go to `\"/login\"` and `\"/admin\"` with a leading slash. That is fine because the console is not published HTML, and the templates correctly use relative `action=\"login\"` / `\"../logout\"`.\n  \n  No outright spec violations found.\n</agent-message>"}

The report follows:\n  **Spec review of T01 (#2)**\n  \n  I fetched #1 and #2, read the whole diff and ran `uv run pytest -q`: 40 passed. I also sent unauthenticated requests to a few URLs: `/admin` gives 303 to `/login`, `/admin/` gives 307 to `/admin`, `/admin/nope` gives 404, and GET `/logout` gives 405.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial**\n  1. One criterion is only partly tested: *\"Tests go through HTTP with the existing `client` / `client_as` fixtures.\"* `test_deactivated_account_is_refused_with_the_right_password` and `test_deactivating_a_logged_in_account_ends_its_session` set up their state by calling `accounts.create_account` / `accounts.set_active` directly. That is defensible because the deactivate route belongs to T02, but it should be noted (and switched to the route in T02). #1 Seam 1 also says *\"never inspect … database rows when a response … can show the same thing.\"* The argon2 test reads rows, which is fine because HTTP cannot show a stored hash (checklist item 1 reads the database the same way).\n  2. *\"Every console URL except the login page redirects someone who isn't logged in.\"* This holds for `/admin`, which is the only console route so far. An unknown `/admin/...` path returns 404 rather than a redirect. That is harmless now, but each new console router must reuse `dependencies=[Depends(current_account)]`.\n  \n  Nothing else is missing. Every criterion in #2 is covered by a test. Checklist items 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 are all satisfied for login, and logout carries a CSRF token too.\n  \n  **(b) Not asked for (all small and arguably justified)**\n  - An open session ends when its account is deactivated (`current_account` checks `active` on every request). This goes past *\"refused at login\"* but matches user stories 10 and 11.\n  - Email is case-insensitive (`_normalize`, `COLLATE NOCASE`), and there is a test for it.\n  - An argon2 check against a dummy hash for unknown emails, so timing doesn't reveal which emails exist (goes past story 5's \"generic error\").\n  - A failed login re-shows the typed email and returns status 401.\n  - `create_app(db_path=...)` gains a parameter. #1 plans `create_app()` to take the deployer later, so the signature will grow; that is fine.\n  - `accounts.set_active` is T02 logic arriving early, used only by tests.\n  - The session cookie ends when the browser closes (`max_age=None`). Not in the spec, but it fits story 3 (a shared laptop).\n  \n  **(c) Implemented but questionable**\n  - The seed creates the admin as `coach@example.test` and the editor as `captain@example.test`, where the template's conftest had `admin@` / `editor@`. Nothing in the spec fixes the emails, but if the grader or a README expects the template's addresses, this breaks their login. Make sure the README or `.env.example` documents them.\n  - `.env.example` still says `CMS_SECRET_KEY=change-me…`, and `settings.SECRET_KEY` falls back to `\"dev-only-not-for-production\"`. That works with *\"Signed session cookies\"*, but sessions can be forged when the key is unset. It's acceptable for a local-only console but worth a note.\n  - The redirects go to `\"/login\"` and `\"/admin\"` with a leading slash. That is fine because the console is not published HTML, and the templates correctly use relative `action=\"login\"` / `\"../logout\"`.\n  \n  No outright spec violations found.\n</agent-message>\n\nThat \"other Claude session\" is an agent working inside this same session — a subagent or teammate spawned on your user's behalf (by you, or alongside you) — so this was not typed by your user. {"parentUuid":"7fccfc57-0294-40dd-99f5-c83f79f2e212","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3KuJnE44PR2AiVJeFnz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01RFWYjAXQ4TFNAgRobJRWze","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"S=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-refiv-ubuncode-iphs400-mp2-cms/c59aef1b-1730-4793-ae15-69d04d1a3927/scratchpad && cat > $S/review.md <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings for T01, and how each was resolved\n\nThe review ran on two separate axes against the uncommitted T01 diff. Final state: `uv run pytest -q` gives **40 passed**.\n\n### Standards (CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, ADRs, plus the smell baseline)\nNo hard violations: forms use relative paths, both POST routes check CSRF, passwords are argon2 only, and no dependencies were added.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| `DEMO_USERS` / `user` in tests uses a term CONTEXT.md says to avoid | **Fixed.** Renamed to `DEMO_ACCOUNTS` / `account`. |\n| Duplicated email lookup in `authenticate` and `find_by_email` | **Fixed.** Both now use the shared `_row_by_email` helper. |\n| Unclear name `_account(row)` | **Fixed.** Renamed to `_from_row`. |\n| Unused `request.state.account` (speculative) | **Fixed.** Removed. |\n| Two ways to choose the test database (`create_app(db_path=)` and monkeypatching `settings`) | **Fixed.** Fixtures pass `db_path` explicitly; nothing monkeypatches settings now. |\n| Tests copied the login error string | **Fixed.** Tests import `LOGIN_ERROR` from `app.routes.auth`. |\n| `set_active` vs. the glossary's \"Deactivated\" | **Kept.** Spec #1 asks for deactivate *and reactivate* (T02), so one setter covers both. |\n| `role: str` primitive; `ROLES` repeats the DB `CHECK` | **Deferred to T02**, where role checks start. The `CHECK` stays as defense in depth. |\n| `current_account` declared on the router and as a route parameter | **Kept.** The router-level dependency guards every console route; the parameter gives the handler the account. FastAPI runs it once per request. |\n| `hello.html` still says \"T00: hello admin\" | **Kept.** The ticket requires the T00 test to keep checking it; T06's dashboard replaces it. |\n\n### Spec (#2, parent #1)\nNo criteria are missing. Every acceptance criterion in #2 has a test.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| Deactivation tests set up state through `accounts.*`, not over HTTP | **Accepted for now.** The deactivate route belongs to T02; switch these tests to it there. Login and logout themselves are tested over HTTP. |\n| Anonymous requests to *unknown* `/admin/...` paths get 404, not a redirect | **Accepted.** Every real console route sits on the console router, whose `current_account` dependency redirects to `/login`. New console routes must use that router. |\n| Demo emails changed from the template's `admin@` / `editor@example.test` | **Fixed.** Reverted to the template addresses. |\n| `CMS_SECRET_KEY` falls back to a dev key | **Noted.** This is pre-existing T00 behaviour and acceptable for a local-only console (ADR-001); set it in `.env`. |\n| Beyond the ticket: case-insensitive email, dummy-hash timing equalization, a live session ends when its account is deactivated, the session cookie ends when the browser closes | **Kept.** Each one directly supports stories 3, 5, 10 and 11. |\nEOF\ngh issue comment 2 --body-file $S/review.md","description":"Post review findings comment on issue #2"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":971,"cache_read_input_tokens":90302,"output_tokens":1567,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":166},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":971,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1567,"cache_read_input_tokens":90302,"cache_creation_input_tokens":971,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":971},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01RFWYjAXQ4TFNAgRobJRWze":{"command":"cd /home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms && S=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-refiv-ubuncode-iphs400-mp2-cms/c59aef1b-1730-4793-ae15-69d04d1a3927/scratchpad && cat > $S/review.md <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings for T01, and how each was resolved\n\nThe review ran on two separate axes against the uncommitted T01 diff. Final state: `uv run pytest -q` gives **40 passed**.\n\n### Standards (CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, ADRs, plus the smell baseline)\nNo hard violations: forms use relative paths, both POST routes check CSRF, passwords are argon2 only, and no dependencies were added.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| `DEMO_USERS` / `user` in tests uses a term CONTEXT.md says to avoid | **Fixed.** Renamed to `DEMO_ACCOUNTS` / `account`. |\n| Duplicated email lookup in `authenticate` and `find_by_email` | **Fixed.** Both now use the shared `_row_by_email` helper. |\n| Unclear name `_account(row)` | **Fixed.** Renamed to `_from_row`. |\n| Unused `request.state.account` (speculative) | **Fixed.** Removed. |\n| Two ways to choose the test database (`create_app(db_path=)` and monkeypatching `settings`) | **Fixed.** Fixtures pass `db_path` explicitly; nothing monkeypatches settings now. |\n| Tests copied the login error string | **Fixed.** Tests import `LOGIN_ERROR` from `app.routes.auth`. |\n| `set_active` vs. the glossary's \"Deactivated\" | **Kept.** Spec #1 asks for deactivate *and reactivate* (T02), so one setter covers both. |\n| `role: str` primitive; `ROLES` repeats the DB `CHECK` | **Deferred to T02**, where role checks start. The `CHECK` stays as defense in depth. |\n| `current_account` declared on the router and as a route parameter | **Kept.** The router-level dependency guards every console route; the parameter gives the handler the account. FastAPI runs it once per request. |\n| `hello.html` still says \"T00: hello admin\" | **Kept.** The ticket requires the T00 test to keep checking it; T06's dashboard replaces it. |\n\n### Spec (#2, parent #1)\nNo criteria are missing. Every acceptance criterion in #2 has a test.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| Deactivation tests set up state through `accounts.*`, not over HTTP | **Accepted for now.** The deactivate route belongs to T02; switch these tests to it there. Login and logout themselves are tested over HTTP. |\n| Anonymous requests to *unknown* `/admin/...` paths get 404, not a redirect | **Accepted.** Every real console route sits on the console router, whose `current_account` dependency redirects to `/login`. New console routes must use that router. |\n| Demo emails changed from the template's `admin@` / `editor@example.test` | **Fixed.** Reverted to the template addresses. |\n| `CMS_SECRET_KEY` falls back to a dev key | **Noted.** This is pre-existing T00 behaviour and acceptable for a local-only console (ADR-001); set it in `.env`. |\n| Beyond the ticket: case-insensitive email, dummy-hash timing equalization, a live session ends when its account is deactivated, the session cookie ends when the browser closes | **Kept.** Each one directly supports stories 3, 5, 10 and 11. |\nEOF\ngh issue comment 2 --body-file $S/review.md","description":"Post review findings comment on issue #2"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

{"parentUuid":"21818ef2-2d9e-438f-983a-b07f2457e003","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3Kw7wAgeFug5VhftSC4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T01 is done and committed to `main` as `14119a4`. The full suite passes (40 tests, including the four T00 tests), and I also logged in against a real running server with `curl`. I didn't push.\n\n**What the ticket now does:**\n- **Login and logout** (`app/routes/auth.py`): a wrong password, an unknown email and a deactivated account all get the same message, \"Incorrect email or password.\" Passwords are stored only as argon2 hashes and never appear in the server log. Both forms carry a CSRF token, and a request without a valid one gets a 403.\n- **Console protection:** anyone not logged in who asks for `/admin` is sent to `/login`. If an account is deactivated while it's logged in, its next request is also sent to `/login`.\n- **Demo seed:** `scripts/seed_demo.py` creates `admin@example.test` and `editor@example.test`, with passwords from `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` / `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD`. It runs clean on an empty database and is safe to run twice. Load `.env` first with `set -a; . ./.env; set +a`.\n- **Tests:** every test gets its own fresh seeded database, so tests never touch your real `cms.db`. `client_as` now reads the CSRF token from the login page before logging in. The T00 admin test logs in with `client_as(\"admin\")` and still checks for \"hello admin\".\n\n**Review:** I ran two reviews, one against the repo's standards and one against the ticket. Neither found a missing requirement or a hard violation. I fixed six smaller findings and recorded the reason for each one I kept or deferred. All of it is in the comment on [#2](https://github.com/RafaelFrias1/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/2#issuecomment-6183847834). Three points carry into later tickets:\n- **Deactivation tests:** two tests set an account inactive by calling the accounts code directly, because the deactivate screen is T02's job. They should switch to that screen in T02.\n- **New console routes** must be added to the existing console router in `app/routes/console.py`, which is what sends visitors who aren't logged in to `/login`. An address under `/admin` that doesn't exist returns \"not found\" rather than the login page.\n- **Session signing key:** if `CMS_SECRET_KEY` isn't set, a built-in development key signs the login cookies. Set it in `.env` on the team laptop.\n\n**Left out of the commit:** I committed the two new session transcripts in `docs/transcripts/`, but not your other uncommitted work: `CONTEXT.md`, `notes/*`, `docs/adr/ADR-004-publish-auto-deploys.md` and `docs/process/compaction-log.md`. They're your spec and grilling work, not T01. {"parentUuid":"4c10207d-014f-4132-b1f4-3d1edac9295d","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e5c5daeb-e421-4e39-9558-481b2158298e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01VSyvtcDvpeUEyFGHEXdLNh","type":"tool_result","content":"title:\tT02 — Coach manages accounts\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tRafaelFrias1\nlabels:\tready-for-agent, ticket\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\tRafaelFrias1/iphs400-mp2-cms#2\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t3\n--\n## Parent\n\n#1\n\n## What to build\n\nThe Coach (admin) manages accounts: creates an account for this season's Captain or Team manager, changes an account's role, and deactivates a graduated Captain (or reactivates an account). Editors can't reach account management at all, including by typing the URL, as in the WordPress field notes where Users was both hidden and denied.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] An admin can create an account with email, initial password and role\n- [ ] An admin can change an account's role\n- [ ] An admin can deactivate and reactivate an account; a deactivated account can't log in\n- [ ] An admin can't deactivate their own account (the request is refused, not just hidden)\n- [ ] Accounts are never deleted; a deactivated account's posts keep its name as author\n- [ ] An editor gets 403 (or a redirect) on every account-management URL and action, including direct GET and POST requests\n- [ ] The account management link appears only for admins\n- [ ] Every account form carries a CSRF token\n- [ ] Tests cover the admin/editor permission matrix through HTTP\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- T01 (#2)\n\"\"\"Accounts: one person's login, with one role (see CONTEXT.md).\n\nPasswords are stored only as argon2 hashes and are never logged. Accounts are\nnever deleted, only deactivated; a deactivated account cannot log in.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom functools import cache\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app import db\n\nROLES = (\"admin\", \"editor\")\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Account:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n\ndef _from_row(row) -> Account:\n    return Account(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n                   active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef _normalize(email: str) -> str:\n    return email.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef create_account(db_path: Path, email: str, password: str, role: str) -> Account:\n    if role not in ROLES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"Unknown role: {role!r}\")\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO accounts (email, password_hash, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n            (_normalize(email), _hasher.hash(password), role),\n        )\n    return get_account(db_path, cursor.lastrowid)\n\n\ndef get_account(db_path: Path, account_id: int) -> Account | None:\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (account_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef _row_by_email(db_path: Path, email: str):\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE email = ?\",\n                            (_normalize(email),)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef find_by_email(db_path: Path, email: str) -> Account | None:\n    row = _row_by_email(db_path, email)\n    return _from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef set_active(db_path: Path, account_id: int, active: bool) -> None:\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE accounts SET active = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                     (int(active), account_id))\n\n\n@cache\ndef _dummy_hash() -> str:\n    return _hasher.hash(\"no account has this password\")\n\n\ndef authenticate(db_path: Path, email: str, password: str) -> Account | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the account if the email and password match an active account.\n\n    Unknown emails still pay for one argon2 verification, so response time\n    does not reveal which emails have accounts.\n    \"\"\"\n    row = _row_by_email(db_path, email)\n    try:\n        _hasher.verify(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _dummy_hash(), password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return None\n    if row is None or not row[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    return _from_row(row)\n\"\"\"The admin console. Every route on this router requires a logged-in account.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app.accounts import Account\nfrom app.web import current_account, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin\", dependencies=[Depends(current_account)])\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, account: Account = Depends(current_account)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"account\": account}\n    )\n\"\"\"What every console route shares: templates, CSRF, and who is logged in.\n\nTwo dependencies do the guarding:\n\n  - `verify_csrf` goes on every state-changing (POST) route. It rejects the\n    request with 403 unless the form's csrf_token matches the session's.\n  - `current_account` goes on every console route (the console router in\n    app/routes/console.py applies it to all of them). Someone who isn't\n    logged in, or whose account was deactivated, is sent to /login.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hmac\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, settings\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `current_account`; create_app() turns it into a redirect.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Put it in every form.\"\"\"\n    if \"csrf\" not in request.session:\n        request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return request.session[\"csrf\"]\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\n\n\ndef verify_csrf(request: Request, csrf_token: str = Form(\"\")) -> None:\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\", \"\")\n    if not (expected and hmac.compare_digest(expected, csrf_token)):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n\n\ndef current_account(request: Request) -> Account:\n    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n    account = (accounts.get_account(request.app.state.db_path, account_id)\n               if account_id is not None else None)\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        request.session.clear()\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return account\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded account of that role, so access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_accounts(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\nEvery test that uses these fixtures gets its own fresh database with the demo\naccounts seeded, so tests never touch your real cms.db.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom app.seed import DEMO_EMAILS, seed_demo\n\n# Emails come from app/seed.py (what scripts/seed_demo.py creates). Passwords\n# come from the environment there; in tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_ACCOUNTS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": DEMO_EMAILS[\"admin\"], \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\"},\n {"parentUuid":"167e6c54-2329-486b-b08a-175ed8206b6a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3L715CGAgs9Vy2SAGhM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01P5kQFLTTasAsH9XH9WEuBv","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t02_accounts.py","content":"\"\"\"T02: the Coach manages accounts (issue #3).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport pytest\nfrom conftest import DEMO_ACCOUNTS\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nADMIN_EMAIL = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"admin\"][\"email\"]\nEDITOR_EMAIL = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"email\"]\n\n\ndef can_log_in(client: TestClient, csrf, email: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    response = client.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                           \"csrf_token\": csrf(client, \"/login\")},\n                           follow_redirects=False)\n    return response.status_code == 303\n\n\ndef post_as(c: TestClient, csrf, path: str, **data: str):\n    data[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf(c, \"/admin\")\n    return c.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# --- creating accounts -------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_creates_an_editor_who_can_then_log_in(client_as, client, csrf):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts\", email=\"manager@example.test\",\n                       password=\"team-manager-pw\", role=\"editor\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/accounts\"\n    listing = admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n    assert \"manager@example.test\" in listing\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, \"manager@example.test\", \"team-manager-pw\")\n\n\ndef test_admin_creates_another_admin(client_as, client, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts\", email=\"webmaster@example.test\",\n            password=\"webmaster-pw\", role=\"admin\")\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, \"webmaster@example.test\", \"webmaster-pw\")\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_creating_an_account_with_a_taken_email_is_refused(client_as, csrf):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts\", email=EDITOR_EMAIL.upper(),\n                       password=\"another-password\", role=\"editor\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"already has an account\" in response.text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"fields, message\", [\n    ({\"email\": \"x@example.test\", \"password\": \"short\", \"role\": \"editor\"},\n     \"at least 8 characters\"),\n    ({\"email\": \"\", \"password\": \"long-enough-pw\", \"role\": \"editor\"},\n     \"Enter an email\"),\n    ({\"email\": \"x@example.test\", \"password\": \"long-enough-pw\", \"role\": \"owner\"},\n     \"Choose a role\"),\n])\ndef test_invalid_new_account_is_refused_and_the_form_keeps_the_email(\n        client_as, csrf, fields, message):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts\", **fields)\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert message in response.text\n    if fields[\"email\"]:\n        assert fields[\"email\"] in response.text\n    assert fields[\"password\"] not in response.text\n\n\n# --- changing roles ----------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_changes_an_editors_role_to_admin(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/role\", role=\"admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_admin_cannot_change_their_own_role(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    me = account_id(admin, ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{me}/role\", role=\"editor\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_changing_to_an_unknown_role_is_refused(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/role\", role=\"owner\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n\n\n# --- deactivating and reactivating -------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_deactivate_then_reactivate(client_as, client, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    password = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"password\"]\n\n    assert post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/active\",\n                   active=\"0\").status_code == 303\n    assert not can_log_in(client, csrf, EDITOR_EMAIL, password)\n    assert \"Deactivated\" in admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n\n    assert post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/active\",\n                   active=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, EDITOR_EMAIL, password)\n\n\ndef test_admin_cannot_deactivate_their_own_account(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    me = account_id(admin, ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{me}/active\", active=\"0\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"your own account\" in response.text\n    assert admin.get(\"/admin\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_unknown_account_is_404(client_as, csrf):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts/999/active\",\n                   active=\"0\").status_code == 404\n    assert post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts/999/role\",\n                   role=\"editor\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_accounts_cannot_be_deleted(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/delete\")\n    assert response.status_code in (404, 405)\n    assert EDITOR_EMAIL in admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n\n\n# --- the permission matrix ---------------------------------------------------\n\nACCOUNT_ROUTES = [\n    (\"get\", \"/admin/accounts\", {}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/accounts\",\n     {\"email\": \"sneaky@example.test\", \"password\": \"sneaky-pw\", \"role\": \"admin\"}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/accounts/{admin_id}/role\", {\"role\": \"editor\"}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/accounts/{admin_id}/active\", {\"active\": \"0\"}),\n]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path, data\", ACCOUNT_ROUTES)\ndef test_editor_is_refused_every_account_route(client_as, client, csrf, account_id,\n                                               method, path, data):\n    admin_id = account_id(client_as(\"admin\"), ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = path.format(admin_id=admin_id)\n    if method == \"get\":\n        response = editor.get(url, follow_redirects=False)\n    else:\n        response = post_as(editor, csrf, url, **data)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    # Nothing changed: the admin can still log in and manage accounts, and the\n    # sneaky account was not created.\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, ADMIN_EMAIL, DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"admin\"][\"password\"])\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n    assert \"sneaky@example.test\" not in client.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path, data\", ACCOUNT_ROUTES)\ndef test_anyone_not_logged_in_is_sent_to_login(client, method, path, data):\n    url = path.format(admin_id=1)\n    response = getattr(client, method)(url, follow_redirects=False,\n                                       **({\"data\": data} if data else {}))\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/admin/accounts\", \"/admin/accounts/1/role\",\n                                  \"/admin/accounts/1/active\"])\ndef test_account_forms_without_csrf_are_rejected(client_as, path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = admin.post(path, data={\"email\": \"x@example.test\", \"password\":\n                                      \"long-enough-pw\", \"role\": \"editor\",\n                                      \"active\": \"0\"}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_account_forms_carry_a_csrf_token(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n    assert page.count('method=\"post\"') >= 3\n    assert page.count('method=\"post\"') == page.count('name=\"csrf_token\"')\n\n\n# --- the console link --------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_accounts_link_appears_only_for_admins(client_as):\n    assert 'href=\"admin/accounts\"' in client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert \"admin/accounts\" not in client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3175,"cache_read_input_tokens":101696,"output_tokens":3392,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":46},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3175,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3392,"cache_read_input_tokens":101696,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3175,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3175},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01P5kQFLTTasAsH9XH9WEuBv":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t02_accounts.py","content":"\"\"\"T02: back)"}]},"uuid":"8ada7058-46c5-4874-994f-c3b560aa5f19","timestamp":"2026-10-15T03:41:59.633Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t02_accounts.py","content":"\"\"\"T02: the Coach manages accounts (issue #3).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport pytest\nfrom conftest import DEMO_ACCOUNTS\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nADMIN_EMAIL = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"admin\"][\"email\"]\nEDITOR_EMAIL = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"email\"]\n\n\ndef can_log_in(client: TestClient, csrf, email: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    response = client.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                           \"csrf_token\": csrf(client, \"/login\")},\n                           follow_redirects=False)\n    return response.status_code == 303\n\n\ndef post_as(c: TestClient, csrf, path: str, **data: str):\n    data[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf(c, \"/admin\")\n    return c.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n# --- creating accounts -------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_creates_an_editor_who_can_then_log_in(client_as, client, csrf):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts\", email=\"manager@example.test\",\n                       password=\"team-manager-pw\", role=\"editor\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/accounts\"\n    listing = admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n    assert \"manager@example.test\" in listing\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, \"manager@example.test\", \"team-manager-pw\")\n\n\ndef test_admin_creates_another_admin(client_as, client, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts\", email=\"webmaster@example.test\",\n            password=\"webmaster-pw\", role=\"admin\")\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, \"webmaster@example.test\", \"webmaster-pw\")\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_creating_an_account_with_a_taken_email_is_refused(client_as, csrf):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts\", email=EDITOR_EMAIL.upper(),\n                       password=\"another-password\", role=\"editor\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"already has an account\" in response.text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"fields, message\", [\n    ({\"email\": \"x@example.test\", \"password\": \"short\", \"role\": \"editor\"},\n     \"at least 8 characters\"),\n    ({\"email\": \"\", \"password\": \"long-enough-pw\", \"role\": \"editor\"},\n     \"Enter an email\"),\n    ({\"email\": \"x@example.test\", \"password\": \"long-enough-pw\", \"role\": \"owner\"},\n     \"Choose a role\"),\n])\ndef test_invalid_new_account_is_refused_and_the_form_keeps_the_email(\n        client_as, csrf, fields, message):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts\", **fields)\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert message in response.text\n    if fields[\"email\"]:\n        assert fields[\"email\"] in response.text\n    assert fields[\"password\"] not in response.text\n\n\n# --- changing roles ----------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_changes_an_editors_role_to_admin(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/role\", role=\"admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_admin_cannot_change_their_own_role(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    me = account_id(admin, ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{me}/role\", role=\"editor\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_changing_to_an_unknown_role_is_refused(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/role\", role=\"owner\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n\n\n# --- deactivating and reactivating -------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_deactivate_then_reactivate(client_as, client, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    password = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"password\"]\n\n    assert post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/active\",\n                   active=\"0\").status_code == 303\n    assert not can_log_in(client, csrf, EDITOR_EMAIL, password)\n    assert \"Deactivated\" in admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n\n    assert post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/active\",\n                   active=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, EDITOR_EMAIL, password)\n\n\ndef test_admin_cannot_deactivate_their_own_account(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    me = account_id(admin, ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{me}/active\", active=\"0\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"your own account\" in response.text\n    assert admin.get(\"/admin\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_unknown_account_is_404(client_as, csrf):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts/999/active\",\n                   active=\"0\").status_code == 404\n    assert post_as(admin, csrf, \"/admin/accounts/999/role\",\n                   role=\"editor\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_accounts_cannot_be_deleted(client_as, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    response = post_as(admin, csrf, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/delete\")\n    assert response.status_code in (404, 405)\n    assert EDITOR_EMAIL in admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n\n\n# --- the permission matrix ---------------------------------------------------\n\nACCOUNT_ROUTES = [\n    (\"get\", \"/admin/accounts\", {}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/accounts\",\n     {\"email\": \"sneaky@example.test\", \"password\": \"sneaky-pw\", \"role\": \"admin\"}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/accounts/{admin_id}/role\", {\"role\": \"editor\"}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/accounts/{admin_id}/active\", {\"active\": \"0\"}),\n]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path, data\", ACCOUNT_ROUTES)\ndef test_editor_is_refused_every_account_route(client_as, client, csrf, account_id,\n                                               method, path, data):\n    admin_id = account_id(client_as(\"admin\"), ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = path.format(admin_id=admin_id)\n    if method == \"get\":\n        response = editor.get(url, follow_redirects=False)\n    else:\n        response = post_as(editor, csrf, url, **data)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    # Nothing changed: the admin can still log in and manage accounts, and the\n    # sneaky account was not created.\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, ADMIN_EMAIL, DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"admin\"][\"password\"])\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n    assert \"sneaky@example.test\" not in client.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path, data\", ACCOUNT_ROUTES)\ndef test_anyone_not_logged_in_is_sent_to_login(client, method, path, data):\n    url = path.format(admin_id=1)\n    response = getattr(client, method)(url, follow_redirects=False,\n                                       **({\"data\": data} if data else {}))\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/admin/accounts\", \"/admin/accounts/1/role\",\n                                  \"/admin/accounts/1/active\"])\ndef test_account_forms_without_csrf_are_rejected(client_as, path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = admin.post(path, data={\"email\": \"x@example.test\", \"password\":\n                                      \"long-enough-pw\", \"role\": \"editor\",\n                                      \"active\": \"0\"}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_account_forms_carry_a_csrf_token(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n    assert page.count('method=\"post\"') >= 3\n    assert page.count('method=\"post\"') == page.count('name=\"csrf_token\"')\n\n\n# --- the console link --------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_accounts_link_appears_only_for_admins(client_as):\n    assert 'href=\"admin/accounts\"' in client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert \"admin/accounts\" not in client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ba85d9af-02b8-4e9a-97a7-2e291b929d72","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"4d76fb33-67f7-426c-a6b4-e10410ba73b3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"c59aef1b-1730-4793-ae15-69d04d1a3927","version":"2.1.300","gitBranch":"main"}

Accounts are never deleted, and nobody may deactivate or demote\ntheir own account, so the site always keeps an admin.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import accounts\nfrom app.accounts import MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH, Account, Role\nfrom app.web import require_admin, templates, verify_csrf\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/accounts\", dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)])\n\n\ndef _page(request: Request, me: Account, *, error: str = \"\", email: str = \"\",\n          role: str = Role.EDITOR, status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/accounts.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Accounts\", \"account\": me, \"roles\": list(Role),\n         \"accounts\": accounts.list_accounts(request.app.state.db_path),\n         \"error\": error, \"email\": email, \"role\": role},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\ndef _back_to_list() -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/accounts\", status_code=303)\n\n\ndef _target(request: Request, account_id: int) -> Account:\n    target = accounts.get_account(request.app.state.db_path, account_id)\n    if target is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such account.\")\n    return target\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_accounts(request: Request, me: Account = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return _page(request, me)\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(verify_csrf)])\ndef create_account(request: Request, me: Account = Depends(require_admin),\n                   email: str = Form(\"\"), password: str = Form(\"\"),\n                   role: str = Form(\"\")):\n    email = email.strip()\n    error = \"\"\n    if not email:\n        error = \"Enter an email.\"\n    elif role not in Role:\n        error = \"Choose a role.\"\n    elif len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        error = f\"The password must be at least {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters.\"\n    else:\n        try:\n            accounts.create_account(request.app.state.db_path, email, password,\n                                    Role(role))\n        except accounts.EmailTaken:\n            error = f\"{email} already has an account.\"\n    if error:\n        return _page(request, me, error=error, email=email, role=role,\n                     status_code=400)\n    return _back_to_list()\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{account_id}/role\", dependencies=[Depends(verify_csrf)])\ndef change_role(request: Request, account_id: int,\n                me: Account = Depends(require_admin), role: str = Form(\"\")):\n    target = _target(request, account_id)\n    if role not in Role:\n        return _page(request, me, error=\"Choose a role.\", status_code=400)\n    if target.id == me.id:\n        return _page(request, me, error=\"You can't change your own role.\",\n                     status_code=400)\n    accounts.set_role(request.app.state.db_path, target.id, Role(role))\n    return _back_to_list()\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{account_id}/active\", dependencies=[Depends(verify_csrf)])\ndef set_active(request: Request, account_id: int,\n               me: Account = Depends(require_admin), active: str = Form(\"\")):\n    target = _target(request, account_id)\n    if active not in (\"0\", \"1\"):\n        return _page(request, me, error=\"Choose deactivate or reactivate.\",\n                     status_code=400)\n    if target.id == me.id and active == \"0\":\n        return _page(request, me, error=\"You can't deactivate your own account.\",\n                     status_code=400)\n    accounts.set_active(request.app.state.db_path, target.id, active == \"1\")\n    return _back_to_list()\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2092,"cache_read_input_tokens":108917,"output_tokens":3017,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":121},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2092,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3017,"cache_read_input_tokens":108917,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2092,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2092},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01UUzL1HoWZLtZ8GuLqsUrEZ":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/accounts.py","content":"\"\"\"Account It reads ambiguously, so use names like `accounts_page` or `create_account_form`.\n- **Speculative Generality / unused parameters:**\n  - The `account_id` fixture takes `csrf` and never uses it.\n  - `test_admin_creates_another_admin` requests `account_id` and never uses it.\n  - The `new_account` default `role: str = \"editor\"` should be `Role.EDITOR` for consistency with `seed.py`.\n- **Data Clumps (minor):** `_page(..., error, email, role)` passes the form's echo-back state as loose keyword arguments. That is fine at this size.\n\n**No issues found:**\n- `app/web.py`: `require_admin` builds on `current_account`, and the docstring was updated.\n- `app/main.py`.\n- `app/seed.py`.\n- The `Role` StrEnum, which is an improvement over the old `ROLES` tuple."},"promptSource":"system","queueSkipSlashCommands":true,"turnOrigin":"peer","turnPosition":{"promptIndex":3,"turnIndex":6},"queueSkipAttachments":true,"userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"c59aef1b-1730-4793-ae15-69d04d1a3927","version":"2.1.300","gitBranch":"main"}

The report follows:\n  Spec review of T02 (#3), checked against the uncommitted diff. `uv run pytest -q` gives 66 passed.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial requirements**\n  None found. Every acceptance criterion in #3 has code and an HTTP test:\n  - Create, change role, deactivate and reactivate: `app/routes/accounts.py`.\n  - Refusing self-deactivation on the server: 400 in `set_active`.\n  - No delete route exists, and `test_accounts_cannot_be_deleted` covers it.\n  - Editor 403 on GET and on every POST: `require_admin` sits on the router, and the editor matrix test is parametrized over all four routes.\n  - The admin-only link: `hello.html`.\n  - CSRF on every form, and the no-token tests.\n  - \"a deactivated account's posts keep its name as author\": nothing blocks it. `set_active` only flips the flag, and no deletion path exists.\n  - Security checklist items 3, 4, 5, 6 and 10 are covered by `test_account_forms_without_csrf_are_rejected`, `test_editor_is_refused_every_account_route`, `test_anyone_not_logged_in_is_sent_to_login`, `test_deactivate_then_reactivate` and the direct-URL matrix.\n  \n  **(b) Behaviour that wasn't asked for (scope creep)**\n  1. **Admins can't change their own role.** `change_role` refuses with \"You can't change your own role.\" The spec says only: \"Nobody may deactivate their own account\", and story 9 is \"I want to change an account's role\". The aim (\"so that the site always keeps an admin\", story 13) does support it, but the rule should be recorded in the spec, `CONTEXT.md` or an ADR rather than added silently. The docstring states it as policy.\n  2. **Minimum password length of 8.** `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` and `minlength=\"8\"` are new rules. The spec asks only for \"create an account with email, initial password and role\". This one is minor and defensible.\n  3. **Helpers moved out of the tests.** `conftest.py` gains `new_account` and `account_id`, and T01's deactivation tests now go through the HTTP route. The spec does say \"permission tests that need a second editor… create one through the admin's account-management route\", so this fits it.\n  \n  **(c) Implemented, but the implementation looks wrong**\n  1. **Error pages on the per-account routes have broken relative URLs.** `change_role` and `set_active` render `accounts.html` inline at `/admin/accounts/{id}/role` or `/admin/accounts/{id}/active`. On that page:\n     - `action=\"accounts/{{a.id}}/role\"` resolves to `/admin/accounts/{id}/accounts/{n}/role`, which is a 404.\n     - \"Back to the console\" (`../admin`) resolves to `/admin/accounts/admin`.\n  \n     So after \"You can't deactivate your own account\", none of the forms on the re-shown page work. Today these error paths are reachable only by crafted requests, because the UI hides self-controls. The fix is to redirect back to `/admin/accounts` (carrying the error) instead of rendering in place.\n  2. **The self-demote rule has no test for the UI side.** \"An admin can't deactivate their own account (the request is refused, not just hidden)\" is satisfied. The self-role refusal is hidden in the UI as well, but nothing checks that.\n  3. **Nothing stops the last active admin from being lost.** Admin A can deactivate or demote admin B, which is allowed. Because self-changes are refused, at least one admin always remains, so story 13's goal holds. No bug, just confirming.\n  \n  Files: `/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/accounts.py`, `/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/accounts.html`.\n</agent-message>"}

The aim (\"so that the site always keeps an admin\", story 13) does support it, but the rule should be recorded in the spec, `CONTEXT.md` or an ADR rather than added silently. The docstring states it as policy.\n  2. **Minimum password length of 8.** `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` and `minlength=\"8\"` are new rules. The spec asks only for \"create an account with email, initial password and role\". This one is minor and defensible.\n  3. **Helpers moved out of the tests.** `conftest.py` gains `new_account` and `account_id`, and T01's deactivation tests now go through the HTTP route. The spec does say \"permission tests that need a second editor… create one through the admin's account-management route\", so this fits it.\n  \n  **(c) Implemented, but the implementation looks wrong**\n  1. **Error pages on the per-account routes have broken relative URLs.** `change_role` and `set_active` render `accounts.html` inline at `/admin/accounts/{id}/role` or `/admin/accounts/{id}/active`. On that page:\n     - `action=\"accounts/{{a.id}}/role\"` resolves to `/admin/accounts/{id}/accounts/{n}/role`, which is a 404.\n     - \"Back to the console\" (`../admin`) resolves to `/admin/accounts/admin`.\n  \n     So after \"You can't deactivate your own account\", none of the forms on the re-shown page work. Today these error paths are reachable only by crafted requests, because the UI hides self-controls. The fix is to redirect back to `/admin/accounts` (carrying the error) instead of rendering in place.\n  2. **The self-demote rule has no test for the UI side.** \"An admin can't deactivate their own account (the request is refused, not just hidden)\" is satisfied. The self-role refusal is hidden in the UI as well, but nothing checks that.\n  3. **Nothing stops the last active admin from being lost.** Admin A can deactivate or demote admin B, which is allowed. Because self-changes are refused, at least one admin always remains, so story 13's goal holds. {"parentUuid":"457012a2-20e2-4909-8a88-5264bcd5964d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3LQ96ND2d8bCbraQfgx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019MttQFnmVXgc77VLPjh4WG","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"S=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-refiv-ubuncode-iphs400-mp2-cms/c59aef1b-1730-4793-ae15-69d04d1a3927/scratchpad && cat > $S/review-t02.md <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings for T02, and how each was resolved\n\nThe review ran on two separate axes against the uncommitted T02 diff. Final state: `uv run pytest -q` gives **67 passed**.\n\n### Bug found by both axes\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| A refusal (for example \"You can't deactivate your own account\") re-rendered the list at `/admin/accounts/N/active`, so the page's relative links and form actions resolved to the wrong addresses (`/admin/accounts/N/accounts/M/role`, a 404) | **Fixed.** A new template global, `root(request)`, gives the relative path back to the site root, and every console link and action is written from it. They stay relative and work at any depth. The new regression test `test_links_still_work_on_a_refusal_page_at_a_deeper_url` follows every link and form action on the refusal page and checks each one reaches a real console route. |\n\n### Standards\nThere were no hard violations. CSRF is on every POST, `require_admin` is enforced at the router (not just by hiding the link), and the vocabulary follows CONTEXT.md.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| The template repeated the minimum password length (`minlength=\"8\"`) | **Fixed.** `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` is passed into the template. |\n| `Role(role)` re-converted inside `accounts.create_account` / `set_role` | **Fixed.** The routes validate and convert; the module trusts its `Role` signature, and the database `CHECK` is the backstop. |\n| `active: str` checked against `\"0\"`/`\"1\"` (a primitive standing in for a bool) | **Fixed.** It is now `active: bool = Form()`, so FastAPI parses the value. |\n| Route handlers had the same names as the `app.accounts` functions they call | **Fixed.** Renamed to `accounts_page`, `add_account` and `change_active`. |\n| The deactivate-and-POST block was duplicated across `test_t01` and `test_t02` | **Fixed.** Moved into a shared `post_form` fixture in conftest. |\n| Unused fixture parameters; `new_account` default role was a plain string | **Fixed.** Removed the unused parameters; the default is `Role.EDITOR`. |\n| `_page(..., error, email, role)` keyword arguments travel together | **Kept.** Fine at this size. |\n\n### Spec (#3, parent #1)\nNo criteria are missing. Every acceptance criterion has an HTTP test, including the editor 403 matrix over every account GET and POST, the anonymous redirect, the CSRF rejection, and the absence of a delete route.\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| Refusing self-demotion (an admin can't change their own role) wasn't in the spec | **Kept, and now recorded.** It serves story 13 (\"the site always keeps an admin\"). Demoting yourself would break that as surely as deactivating yourself. Added to the **Admin** entry in `CONTEXT.md`. |\n| Minimum password length of 8 wasn't in the spec | **Kept.** It's a small, defensible rule. |\n| \"A deactivated account's posts keep its name as author\" | **Nothing blocks it.** Deactivation only flips a flag and there is no delete path. The check that a deactivated author's name still shows on their posts belongs in T03 (#4), once posts exist. |\n| Last-admin safety | **Confirmed.** Because no admin can change their own account, at least one active admin always remains. |\nEOF\ngh issue comment 3 --body-file $S/review-t02.md","description":"Post T02 review findings on issue #3"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":557,"cache_read_input_tokens":133685,"output_tokens":1397,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":557,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1397,"cache_read_input_tokens":133685,"cache_creation_input_tokens":557,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":557},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_019MttQFnmVXgc77VLPjh4WG":{"command":"cd /home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms && S=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-refiv-ubuncode-iphs400-mp2-cms/c59aef1b-1730-4793-ae15-69d04d1a3927/scratchpad && cat > $S/review-t02.md <<'EOF'\n## /code-review findings for T02, and how each was resolved\n\nThe review ran on two separate axes against the uncommitted T02 diff.
